items.title_cn: Anthropic Console overcharged my card 100x due to internationalization input bug
items.title_en: Anthropic Console overcharged my card 100x due to internationalization input bug
items.summary_cn:
I am a LegalTech Attorney leading a developer team from Costa Rica. While trying to load credits onto my Anthropic API account (claude.com), I experienced a critical internationalization (i18n) and UX failure that has placed an unfair financial burden on me due to a severe oversight in their payment pipeline.

The platform prompted me for a payment. Since I am in a Spanish-speaking region where localized systems and keyboards handle dots and commas differently, I typed 5.04.

Anthropic’s input

items.title_en: An Nvidia insider-turned-VC on why robotics hasn’t hit its ChatGPT moment, yet
items.summary_cn: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is currently in its “Lego era,” with the basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt.  This view runs counter to those who believe that robotics, powered by a general foundation model, is about to have […]
